title: ageratina cuencana
intro: Ageratina cuencana, commonly known as Ecuadorian mint or Cuencana mint, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. It is widely used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including the reduction of inflammation and the alleviation of symptoms associated with digestive issues, such as nausea and diarrhea. The therapeutic actions of Ageratina cuencana are attributed to its ability to relax muscles, reduce fever, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic compounds, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
